# Yakeen Lighting

> Your Trusted Middle East Commercial Lighting Partner. SASO & G-Mark certified LED commercial lighting with OEM/ODM customization. Serving Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman.

## About
- Company: Taiyuan Yakeen Trading Co., Ltd. (operating as Yakeen Lighting)
- Focus: Middle East commercial lighting solutions
- Products: LED Downlights, Spotlights, Track Lights, Panel Lights, Linear Lights, High Bay, Flood Lights, Solar Street Lights, Wall Washers, Strip Lights
- Certifications: SASO, G-Mark, CE, RoHS, ISO 9001:2015
- Services: Free DIALux design, OEM/ODM customization, 5-stage QC, SABER registration, DDP shipping
- Founder: Alan Ma
